description:
## What to do

Adapt the upstream settings doc (tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/docs/settings.md, 248 lines) for our Elixir system.

## Upstream source

- tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/docs/settings.md
- tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/src/core/settings.ts (reference)

## Output

Create docs/settings.md

## How to adapt

1. **Location table**: Update paths from `~/.pi/agent/settings.json` and `.pi/settings.json` to our paths. Check our `OctoPi.Coder.SettingsManager` for actual paths.

2. **All Settings tables**: Convert each setting category:
   - **Model & Thinking**: defaultProvider, defaultModel, defaultThinkingLevel, hideThinkingBlock, thinkingBudgets
   - **UI & Display**: theme, quietStartup, collapseChangelog, enableInstallTelemetry, doubleEscapeAction, treeFilterMode, editorPaddingX, autocompleteMaxVisible, showHardwareCursor
   - **Compaction**: compaction.enabled, compaction.reserveTokens, compaction.keepRecentTokens
   - **Branch Summary**: branchSummary.reserveTokens, branchSummary.skipPrompt
   - **Retry**: retry.enabled, retry.maxRetries, retry.baseDelayMs, retry.maxDelayMs
   - **Message Delivery**: steering mode, followUp mode
   - **Extensions**: extension sources, extension paths
   - **Skills**: enableSkillCommands, skill locations
   - **Prompt Templates**: prompt template sources
   - **Themes**: theme discovery
   - **Shell**: shellCommandPrefix, shellPath

3. **thinkingBudgets**: Show our equivalent config. Check if our SettingsManager supports nested keys.

4. **Retry settings**: Update the exponential backoff description (2s, 4s, 8s) — verify it matches our implementation.

5. **Message Delivery**: Document steering_mode and follow_up_mode settings.

6. **Extensions**: Document extension source configuration.

7. **Skills**: Document skill discovery paths.

8. **Prompt Templates**: Document prompt template discovery.

## What to preserve verbatim

- The settings JSON schema (keys and values)
- The compaction settings example
- The retry settings example
- The description of each setting

## Key upstream references to include

- [settings.ts](https://github.com/badlogic/pi-mono/blob/main/packages/coding-agent/src/core/settings.ts)
- [settings-manager.ts](https://github.com/badlogic/pi-mono/blob/main/packages/coding-agent/src/core/settings-manager.ts)

## Testing the doc

After writing, verify:
1. All setting names match our actual SettingsManager
2. All defaults match our actual defaults
3. All paths are correct for our config directory
4. The nested key syntax (compaction.enabled) matches our SettingsManager API
